issues.problem: Distractor そうで gives 高そうで、買いませんでした ('looked expensive, so I didn't buy it'), a natural sentence close to the intended meaning; not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced そうで with くなって (高くなって = 'went up in price'), which contradicts the English for every adjective value.

issues.problem: ill value 熱 gives 熱が早く良くなる, which is unnatural (a fever 下がる; it does not 良くなる).
issues.action: Removed the 熱 value; 6 ill values remain (6x8x6 = 288 combinations).
